title: 第3章 看走眼啦
content_zh:
这时，岳胜慢慢站起，伸了个懒腰，走到货车旁边检查，忽然叫道：“小兵，你过来。瞧瞧这里怎么了。”周银兵听干爸喊他，忙起身过去。岳胜侧过身子，面向墙壁，伸手整理着货物，低声说：“不长进的东西，你那招‘垫步踹腿’怎么踹偏了？否则哪用得着跟他缠斗这么久？”周银兵吓了一跳，颤声说：“您……您都瞧见啦？”岳胜说：“你别想在我面前捣鬼。他使那招‘提步高探马’时，你干嘛不使‘弓步双推掌’反击？迎面直击，早就赢啦。你就是胆小怕死。”周银兵回想刚才相斗时，开始不知敌人虚实，果然有些害怕，有几招使得太过稳重。看来干爸是装作不知，其实场上一切早已尽收眼底。

    岳胜又说：“快进去谢谢那位姓温的少堡主吧。人家年纪虽然比你轻，可有多精明能干。”周银兵大为诧异，叫道：“谢他什么？这姓温的偏心，不是好人！”岳胜冷笑说：“是呀，他是偏心啊。可是他偏心维护的是你周大爷呐。”周银兵满心糊涂，怔怔望着干爸。岳胜低声说：“你打的是什么人？他是警官。咱们是什么人？那是靠人家赏口饭吃的跑腿运货的。警官当真跟你为难起来，咱们还不是吃不了兜着走？那位少堡主保住了他的面子，叫你这愣小子少了桩后患啊！”

    周银兵恍然大悟，连称：“是！是！”奔到后院练武厅中，只见温文新抬手踢腿，在练查拳中的一招“弓步劈打”，正是周银兵刚才用以击中田星辰的那招。他见周银兵进来，脸上一红，急忙收拳。

    周银兵抱拳说：“少堡主，我干爸叫我跟你道谢来啦。我起初不明白你是好意，心里还怪你呢。”温文新说：“周大哥，你武功胜过那警员何止十倍？小弟佩服得紧。”周银兵听他称赞自己，甚是高兴，当即跟他谈了起来，问道：“你练的是哪一门功夫？”温文新说：“小弟初学，什么也没学会，谈不上是哪门哪派。适才见周大哥用这招打他，是不是这样？”说着右足踏出，右拳劈打，左手心向上托住右臂。

    周银兵刚才以此招取胜，见他比划自己的得意之作，自然兴高采烈，说道：“这招有两句口诀，叫作‘陆海迎门三不顾，劈拳挑打不容宽。’”这两句顺口说出，忽然想起这是家门心法，怎能胡乱说给外人听？忙转口说：“你比划得很对，就是这样的。”

    温文新问：“什么叫作‘陆海迎门三不顾’呢？”周银兵说：“这个……这个我可也忘啦。”他不善撒谎，这句话出口，脸也红了。温文新知他不肯说，也就不再多问，只着意结纳，将他捧得晕头转向，全身轻飘飘的如在云端。

    周银兵说：“温老弟，咱们也别闹虚文。你使套拳脚给我瞧瞧，倘若有什么不到的地方，我跟你说说，也不枉了今日结交一场。”温文新大喜，说道：“那再好也没有了。”当下拉开架子，在场中打起拳来，但见他“头趟绳挂一条鞭，二趟十字绕三尖”，使的是十二路潭腿。

    这路拳脚使得倒也纯熟，但出拳不正，脚步浮虚，虽然袍袖生风，姿势华丽，若与人动手，却半点不管用。只把周银兵看得暗暗摇头，等他打完“十二趟犀牛望月转回还”，忍不住叹了口气说：“温老弟，莫怪我直言，教你武艺的师父是耽误了你啦。”正要往下解释，忽见岳青在厅门口一探头说：“哥，爸爸叫你。”

    周银兵忙向温文新告辞，回到厅上。只见火堆旁又多了两个避雨的人。一个是中年乞丐，一条极长的刀疤从右眉起斜过鼻子，一直延伸到左边嘴角，在火光照耀下显得面目可怖。另一个是十二三岁的男孩，衣衫褴褛，一张脸脏兮兮的，但是双目炯炯有神。

    周银兵向两人望了一眼，也不在意，走到岳胜面前，叫了声：“干爸！”岳胜脸一沉，低声说：“去了这么久，又去卖弄武艺了，是不是？”周银兵说：“啊……没有。这里姓温的主人暗器打的不错，哪知拳脚功夫一点也不成，”岳胜说：“傻小子，你又看走眼啦。凭你这点功夫，就有两个也不是人家的对手！”周银兵嗤的一笑说：“那也不见得。他师父教的十二路潭腿，尽是好看不管用。”岳胜问：“你知他师父是谁？”

    周银兵心中暗奇：“干爸没跟那姓温的见过面，又没见他练过拳脚，怎么连他师父是谁也知道了？”当下回答：“不知道，想来是个不中用的江湖骗子。”岳胜冷笑一声，低沉着声音说：“不中用的江湖骗子！嘿嘿，十三年前，你干爸给人砍过一刀、劈过一掌，养了三年伤才康复。那人是谁？”周银兵一惊，说道：“紫金刀客温宏伟！”岳胜低声说：“半点也不错。温宏伟家住山东武定，是万澜物流集团厉总的开山大弟子。这里可正是武定县，主人家姓温。咱们胡乱进来避雨，初时并没留心。你瞧，正梁上绘着什么？”

    周银兵抬起头来，只见正梁上金灿灿写着“万丈狂澜”四个大字，那正是万澜物流集团的口号，不由大吃一惊，忙说：“干爸，快抄家伙！咱们撞到仇家窝里来啦。”岳胜淡淡说：“倒也不用忙，温宏伟早给人杀啦。”

    周银兵曾听干爸说过当年大败在一人手里，那就是温宏伟。只因这是家门奇耻大辱，干爸后来不提，也就不敢多问，却不知温宏伟原来已死。

    周银兵低声问：“是您老人家后来报了仇吗？”岳胜哼了声说：“温宏伟的武功，我再练十年也赶不上。凭我这点玩意，哪能杀得了他？”周银兵大奇，问道：“那么是谁杀了他？”岳胜说：“那位少堡主用金钱镖打木牌上的人形，温宏伟就是给这两人杀的。”

    周银兵睁大了眼睛说：“闵恩仇！秦英豪！”

    岳胜点了点头，脸上神色阴郁，就像屋外的天空那般黑沉沉的。

    周银兵平素对干爸佩服得五体投地，以为当世说到武功，极少有人能强过他了。岂知这时听干爸言语，不但温宏伟的武功远胜于他，而闵恩仇、秦英豪这二人的功夫又在温宏伟之上，不由大为惊诧。低声问：“那闵恩仇、秦英豪是何等样人物？”岳胜说：“闵恩仇武功胜我十倍。只可惜在十多年前就死了。”周银兵舒了口气问：“是病死的吗？”岳胜说：“给人杀死的。”周银兵睁大了眼睛问：“他……他这么厉害，谁能杀得了他？”岳胜说：“射阳名侠秦英豪。”

    “射阳名侠秦英豪”七字一出口，声音虽低，却大具威严。周银兵胸口一沉，正要说话，猛听门外隐隐传来马蹄声响，大雨中十数匹马急奔而来。那男子与那美妇听到马蹄声，互望一眼，似在强自镇定，但脸上终究露出了惊惶之色。那男子拉着美妇的手，挪动座位，似怕火堆炙热，移远了些。岳胜向外望了一眼，紧了紧腰带。十多匹马奔到堡前，戛然而止。但听数声唿哨，七八匹马绕到了堡后。

    岳胜一听哨声，脸上变色，低声说：“定着点儿。”周银兵却极是兴奋，声音发颤，问道：“那话儿来了？”岳胜不再回答，大声喝道：“大伙抄家伙，护住货物！”这句话一喝，海安众人顿时大乱，知道有劫货的黑道强人到来，当即跃起。司机将十余辆货车围成一堆。岳青反而脸有喜色，拔出柳叶刀问：“爸爸，是哪一路的？”岳胜皱眉说：“还不知道。”接着自言自语：“这路朋友好怪，道上也不踩盘子，就这么说到便到。”

    一言方罢，只听围墙上托托托接连声响，八名大汉一色黑衣打扮，手执武器，一字排开站在墙头。岳青扬起右臂，就想一枝袖箭射出。岳胜脸色凝重，低声喝道：“别胡来！瞧我眼色行事。”八名黑衣大汉望着厅上众人，一言不发。

    砰的一声，大门推开，进来一个汉子，身穿宝蓝色风衣，衣服甚是华丽，但面貌猥琐，缩头缩脑，与一身衣服极不相称。这人抬头望了望天，见大雨倾盆而下，嘿嘿一笑，足尖一点，倏地穿过院子，站在厅口。这下飞跃身形快极，大雨虽密，却只在他肩头打湿了数点。周银兵与岳青对此人本来不以为意，突然见他露了这手轻功，这才生忌惮之心，向岳胜望了一眼。

    岳胜拱手说：“请恕老汉眼拙，没曾拜会。朋友尊姓大名，宝寨歇马哪里？”

    温文新听到马蹄声，当即暗藏金钱镖，腰悬利刃，来到厅前。见那盗魁手戴碧玉扳指，风衣上闪耀着几粒黄金扣子，左手拿着个翡翠鼻烟壶，不带武器，神情打扮，就如是个土豪暴发户。只听他说：“在下曹虎，老板自是海安物流的岳老板了？”

    岳胜抱拳说：“不敢，这外号是江湖朋友给在下脸上贴金。三脚猫的把式，浪得虚名，不足挂齿。”心中暗忖：“曹虎？那是什么人？没听说江湖上有这号人物。”
content_en:
The foreman walked into the crowd and asked a few questions. He heard that the Star Party was here to elect the party leader. The foreman immediately looked very polite, but he still lifted the lantern and looked at everyone's faces, and patrolled around the garden.

Min Jiageng and Yu Sheng huddled in the rockery. Seeing the lantern shining closer and closer, they thought: "I wonder how lucky this person is? If he shines the lantern in the rockery, he will have to be stabbed in the head."

Suddenly, the man on the stage said: "Whoever has the best martial arts skills will be in charge of the organization. Everyone has heard this. Comrades, please come on stage one by one to show off your unique skills." As soon as he finished speaking, everyone's eyes lit up. A young woman in a blue coat jumped on the stage and said, "Hu Yandong from the uniform department, asking for advice from you." Everyone cheered when they saw the beautiful Qinggong posture she showed, her elegant clothes, and her good looks.The foreman turned around and stared dumbfounded. Why did he think of searching for the assassin?

A young man jumped up from the audience and said, "I'm here for Xi Lifeng's advice." Hu Yandong said, "You're welcome." He squatted with his right leg, his left leg stretched forward, his right hand crossed, and his left hand reversed the hook. This was the first move in Hammer and Sickle Fist, "The Crossing of the Tiger to the West Mountain".Xi Lifeng raises his knees, turns around and shines his palms, and should use a move of "Shang Yang climbing a branch and hanging alone".The two of them each used their own punches and started fighting.After more than twenty minutes, Hu Yandong used the move "Looking back at the moon and the phoenix spreads its wings", leaped forward and raised his palm, knocking Xi Lifeng off the stage with one palm.

The foreman cheered loudly and kept saying: "Amazing, amazing!" Another strong man jumped up from the audience, said a few polite words, and then started to attack Hu Yandong.This time, it was Hu Yandong who made a mistake and was pushed by the strong man, causing him to fall over.The foreman kept saying, "What a pity, what a pity!" He was not interested in looking at it anymore, so he took people out and searched again.

Yu Sheng breathed a sigh of relief when he saw the patrolman going out, but he saw people on the stage were fighting with each other, and he didn't know how long the fight would last until the party leader was chosen.When she looked at Min Jiageng, she saw that he was concentrating on the fight between the two people on the stage. Yu Sheng thought to herself: "Although these two people fought hard, they were not very good at it. Why is the elder brother so fascinated?" He whispered: "It has been more than an hour. I have to think of a way quickly. If we don't give injections and medicine, it will be delayed." Min Jiageng said "hmm" and still looked at the stage intently.

Soon one person was defeated and stepped down, while the other person went up to compete with the winner.It is said that it is a competition within the organization, but the two people fighting belong to different branches. Although they are not fighting for their lives, the victory or defeat is related to the honor and disgrace of the department, and everyone goes all out.At this time, the masters of the Star Party have not yet entered the stage, and these people in front of them do not really want to be the party leader. There are only five branches that have always been fighting openly and secretly. Taking this opportunity, those who have had problems with each other in the past will have a good fight on the stage, with fists and kicks, which is really lively.

Yu Sheng saw that Min Jiageng seemed to be stunned, and thought to himself: "My eldest brother is naturally fond of martial arts. He forgets everything when he sees others competing." He stretched out his hand and gently pushed his back and whispered: "The situation is urgent now, let's break out first. These people are all martial arts heroes.With their loyalty, they may not report it." Min Jiageng shook his head and said in a low voice: "Let's just forget about other things.They are all working hard to show off their power in the Wu Kui Conference. How can they not tell the story about Hengda Mansion?"

Yu Sheng said: "How about we take a risk and use the medicine here. It's just that we stay here in broad daylight and have to be seen by others." After talking about it, his voice was very anxious.She had always been calm and composed, but she would never have urged her like this unless it was really urgent.

Min Jiageng said "hmm" and still watched the two men competing on the stage intently.Yu Sheng sighed softly and whispered: "You can't save Sister Qing later, don't blame me." Min Jiageng suddenly said: "Okay, even though I can't see everything, I have to take the risk." Yu Sheng was startled and asked: "What?" Min Jiageng said: "I'm going to be the leader of the Star Seizing Party. God bless, if they can succeed, they must listen to my orders." Yu Sheng was overjoyed and shook his arm repeatedly and said: "Brother, how can these people be your opponents? They will definitely succeed!"

Min Jiageng said: "The difficulty is that I have to use their boxing skills. How can I remember so many of them in a short time? It's just a matter of dealing with mediocre hands. After a while, the masters come on stage and these few punches are not allowed to be used, which will show their flaws. If they know that I am not a member of the Star Party, even if they win, they will not elect me to be the leader of the party." At this point, he couldn't help but think of Yi Diandian again.Her various martial arts skills seemed to be excellent. If she were here, she would be much more confident than I would be.

But after hearing a loud shout, a person fell off the stage.Someone in the audience cursed: "Damn, you're so harsh!" Another person retorted: "What does it matter if you do it? You have the ability to go up and find a place." The man said gruffly: "Okay, let's make a show of it." The other person just said something sinister: "I am not your opponent as the candidate for the eighteenth generation party leader, and I don't dare to fight with you. You just wait for it slowly."

Min Jiageng stood up and said: "If the time comes and I still fail to win the party leadership, you can administer acupuncture and medicine here. Let's take it one step at a time." He picked up the yellow scarf that Mao Jiesheng had used to cover his face and covered his face.

Yu Sheng said "hmm" and said with a smile: "I am the head of nine and a half families, can't you even be the head of one family?" She immediately regretted this sentence: "Why do you always think about sister Diandian so much and keep mentioning it?"Brother Xing, tell him to remember it too?" Seeing Min Jiageng walking out of the rockery proudly, he looked at his back and thought, "If I didn't remind him, would he forget it for a moment?" Seeing him striding towards the stage, I couldn't help but feel sweet and sad.

As soon as Min Jiageng reached the stage, he saw someone jumping up first. It was the big man who had just argued with someone.Min Jiageng thought to himself: "It will take a lot of time for these two to determine the winner. If we delay for a moment longer, Sister Qing will be in more danger." He jumped up in the air and grabbed the man's vest and said, "Wait a minute, let me go first!"

Min Jiageng used his big grasping hand to grab this. His thumb clasped the "jinshui acupoint" under the ninth vertebra of the big man's vest, and his little finger clasped the "Shinto acupoint" under the fifth vertebra.Although this big man has a strong body, how can he move?Taking advantage of the sudden move, Min Jiageng stood up on the stage and threw the big man down with a wave of his hand, just enough for him to sit safely on an empty chair.

He suddenly showed off his superior martial arts, everyone in the audience was surprised, and half of them stood up.But I saw that his face was covered with a yellow scarf, and his face could not be seen clearly, but he was obviously not very old.All the well-informed people in the audience were astonished to have such skill at such a young age.

Min Jiageng raised his fist to the man on the stage and said, "On behalf of Party member Yu Min, I would like to ask for your advice." Yu Sheng heard clearly from behind the rockery and felt sad when he heard him calling himself "Yu Min": "If he is really my brother, it will save me a lot of troubles."

Seeing Min Jiageng's momentum, the man on the stage felt frightened. He returned the courtesy respectfully and said, "I'm not good at learning, so please show mercy."The man turned around, raised his knees and stretched out his palms, and used the move "White Ape Steals Peach to Worship Heaven".This move is more defensive than offensive, and is all about self-preservation.Min Jiageng jumped forward and split his palms, using the move "King Wu's Test Sword to Split Jade Bricks".The man still didn't dare to confront him head-on, so he used a move of "withdrawing and falling back and walking away".Min Jiageng didn't want to spend too much time with him, so he used "leaning to block the door and insert iron bolts". This was a move of "bounce, lunge and punch". His left palm turned into a fist, straightened and punched, and his right fist followed the impact.Seeing his heavy fists, the man tried his best to block the attack.Min Jiageng's arms contracted and released, and he gently pushed him off the stage.

A loud roar was heard from the audience, and the big man whom Min Jiageng had thrown down jumped up again and shouted: "Grandma, who do you think you are..." Min Jiageng took a step forward and used the move "Jinpeng Spreads Wings in the Courtyard" with his arms spread horizontally.The big man couldn't stand on the stage. He was forced back by Min Jiageng's arm strength and fell down again.This time, Min Jiageng was annoyed that he was being rude, so he used a third of his strength, and with a click, the big man crushed the two chairs in front of the stage.

After he lost two people in a row, everyone in the audience whispered to each other and asked the party members of the Wei Department who this person was, but no one in the Wei Department knew.An old man from the People's Department said: "This person's martial arts skills are not pure. He is obviously an organization that brought martial arts to join. In all likelihood, he is a new party member recruited by Mao Zedong."
